findings.text: Official Giants coverage confirms the completed 34-27 loss and McCarthy replacing Winston with 11:25 remaining. This is a game-specific quarterback change, not proof of a Week 7 appointment.

AP reports Winston 14/26 for 152 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions; McCarthy 11/21 for 243 yards. Harbaugh had not selected the next starter. McCarthy entered down 34-10, so the late passing sample is strongly game-script selected.
findings.confidence: HIGH for attributed results; future role unresolved

findings.text: PFT likewise reports the next-start decision remained open.
findings.confidence: HIGH for attribution; same press-conference event, not independent forecasts

findings.text: Next-week pass-catcher opportunity should use separate starter scenarios with uncertain weights. Extrapolating McCarthy's short high-volume comeback sample to a normal full game would ignore selection by deficit, opponent behavior and playing time.

hypothesis.text: Starter-scenario forecasts outperform pooling emergency replacement-quarter rates with ordinary starts.
hypothesis.test: Preserve each pregame starter probability, attempts and target allocation. Evaluate later weeks with chronological holdout and game-clustered uncertainty; retain wrong-starter predictions rather than dropping them.
hypothesis.failure_condition: Reject if held-out predictive scores do not improve after accounting for replacement sample selection.

prior_expectation_review: Earlier public education required conditional opportunity scenarios rather than status-only conclusions. The quarterback change adds an unresolved scenario; it supplies no retroactive probability forecast or decision grade.
